beats.title: Crafting fair relocated; Bonogo makes self-cleaning goo
beats.summary: The crafting booths are moved from the town square due to a large hole, with flyers advertising the new location. Bonogo visits the goblin alchemy booth and instead of a bubble potion creates a mobile green cleaning goo.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-10:8482ee1639ec:span:8482ee1639ec:1-14
anchor_quotes: a green goo that has a mind of its own and is able to clean as it moves around

beats.title: Runic wood carving challenge at Splitbark's booth
beats.summary: At the runic wood carving booth run by Splitbark, Ephanna, Karsemine, and Caelynn attempt to carve a rune coaster. Ephanna excels and wins a Warding Rune, Caelynn does well, and Karsemine struggles.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-10:8482ee1639ec:span:8482ee1639ec:1-14
anchor_quotes: Ephanna, Karsemine and Caelynn all join in. With a little help from their Fey connection, Ephanna does extremely well and is rewarded with a Warding Rune.

beats.title: Fey candy tent: creations, a stolen lollipop, and an unseen watcher
beats.summary: At the Fey candy tent, the group attempts Illusion Lollipops. Karsemine creates everlasting taffy, Caelynn makes all-sour lollipops, Ephanna succeeds, and Bonogo's lollipop turns into a fur monster. Bonogo then steals a child's lollipop and feels someone watching him.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-10:8482ee1639ec:span:8482ee1639ec:16-16
anchor_quotes: Bonogo steals one of the lollipops from a nearby child. Just then he feels like someone or something is standing behind him, but when he turns nothing is there.

beats.title: Stormbark Tea and smithing with Baergrom
beats.summary: Caelynn excels at the sleepy tea booth and learns to make Stormbark Tea. At the mini forge, Baergrom impresses an old dwarf and helps make copper medallions after being offered a job.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-10:8482ee1639ec:span:8482ee1639ec:16-16
anchor_quotes: She shows Caelynn how to create Stormbark Tea.
the old dwarf asks if he is willing to help with a job. Baergrom then spends the rest of the crafting time helping make copper medallions.

beats.title: Druidic carving, illusion painting, and bone jewelry booths
beats.summary: The group is recognized by the Grove for ending the Hempholm abomination and attempts a dryad charm. Ephanna excels at illusion painting of Council members, and at the bone jewelry booth Ephanna makes a windchime, Karsemine crafts a danger-sensing charm, and Bonogo makes a compliment-whispering bone ring.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-10:8482ee1639ec:span:8482ee1639ec:18-18
anchor_quotes: the “Grove” appreciates all the help ending the abomination in Hempholm
Bonogo is able to make a special bone ring that whispers compliments.

beats.title: Storm Magic booth: Caelynn learns of the nomadic professor
beats.summary: At the Storm Magic booth, the old human running it tells Caelynn about a human professor from the academy who left after reaching the pinnacle of magic. Their last known location was Bald Green Hill in the mountains.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-10:8482ee1639ec:span:8482ee1639ec:18-18
anchor_quotes: tells her about a human professor the academy once had

beats.title: Coliseum finale against three summoned Elementals
beats.summary: The group heads to the Coliseum finale, where three teams face three summoned Elementals — Lightning, Stone, and a giant glass of ale — while earning crowd favor. Bonogo, Ogonob, and Baergrom fight; Bonogo attacks the ale, Ogonob shatters it but is blinded, and the Stone Elemental walls off Baergrom and knocks him prone.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-10:8482ee1639ec:span:8482ee1639ec:20-20
anchor_quotes: The fighters, Bonogo, Ogonob and Baergrom, arrange themselves in the center of the arena. Then 3 Elementals are summoned: Lightning, Stone, and strangest of all, a huge foaming glass of ale.

beats.title: Bonogo spots a hooded watcher in the stands
beats.summary: Bonogo again feels watched during the fight, scans the crowd, and sees a dark hooded figure observing from the stands.
